map.土方量平均断面法：V = (A₁+A₂)÷2×L（m³，A₁/A₂ 为相邻两断面: Average end-area method: V = (A₁+A₂)÷2×L (m³, A₁/A₂ are the cut/fill areas of adjacent sections and L is the section length); linked values: average section area = (A₁+A₂)÷2 (m²), volume per meter = V÷L (m³/m). Validation: section areas must be non-negative and the section length must be greater than 0, otherwise a message is shown (no fallback to 0 or division by zero). Criteria: no fixed classification; thousand-m³ output helps summarize large earthwork; results keep two to three decimals.

map.断面 A₁=100 m²、A₂=60 m²、间距 L=20m → V=(100+: Section A₁=100 m², A₂=60 m², spacing L=20 m → V = (100+60)/2×20 = 1600 m³.
map.全线挖方求和、填方求和，差为正需借土/弃土，平衡优化运距降成本。: Sum cut and fill along the line; a positive difference needs borrow/ waste soil, and balancing optimizes haul distance to cut cost.
map.平均端面积准吗？: Is the average end area accurate?
map.断面线性变化时尚可，起伏大用棱镜体公式更准，否则低估/高估。: Acceptable when sections change linearly; for large variation use the prismoidal formula for better accuracy, otherwise under/over-estimate.
map.间距越小越准但工作量增，平原稀、地形复杂密，按规范定。: Smaller spacing is more accurate but more work; sparse on plains, dense in complex terrain, set per specification.
